notes: Used all 8 searches. The two crisis sentences (999, NHS 111 mental health option, Samaritans 116 123) are now backed by retrieved NHS wording (NHS 'Help for suicidal thoughts' and a GP-practice page titled 'NHS 111 - option 2 for crisis mental health support'); the 111 option rests on an NHS GP-practice page, a human may want to confirm it against nhs.uk/nhs-services/mental-health-services. Cut: SSRI reabsorption sentence, low sodium and dextromethorphan case reports, PMDD, driving advice, 'talk to your doctor' pregnancy line, 'keep taking when well' MedlinePlus claim. Corrected: children's use is OCD only (NHS), not teen depression. Several search summaries blend pages, so URL attribution within NHS sertraline pages is best effort. The existing site entry says sertraline is 'a first choice after a heart attack' and 'better-studied in pregnancy': not checked here. The "extra care" and "other medicines" sections were merged into one; final article has 5 sections, 4 FAQs, 6 keyFacts.
